text.text_excerpt: It was Mother's Day when we drove by this place and decided to try it out. We ordered the Dates and Bacon which had a blue cheese dipping sauce to start with and they were good, but small. I wanted to order the Steak A La Pobre, but they were out. So we went with the El Cubano and Pirogues Falafel Burger. I thought the El Cubano was ok, but my boyfriend liked it. Now, the Falafel Burger is delicious! It tasted like a Doritos taco burger! The patty is made with arugula, tomatoes, avocado, and tahini dressing. I think I found a new place to have a veggie burger. If you haven't tried it, go try it! For dessert, I ordered the Nutella donut holes and they were good. Be careful to let them cool...

Great spot! Try the food - so tasty! Good drinks, good food, and good company whether you're stopping in for something quick or staying for hours. Bartenders are always nice, and laid back just like the atmosphere. Their featured drinks are great, too! The food was surprisingly different in selection from other places in the area. We've tried a lot of the menu and haven't been disappointed with anything. That said, fried nutella??? That's a must try for dessert! For a quick date night stop, or to watch a football game, definitely recommend this place.

I love surprises! From the outside, Pirogues fits right in with its scruffy-looking neighbors, looking every bit the dive bar you'd expect on this stretch of Broad. The interior goes right along with it, lots of Saints stuff and an old wooden pirogue mounted on the wall behind the bar that serves as a shelf for the bottles. But the menu is definitely not dive-bar. It leans toward healthy and Mediterranean without getting all foodie. After days of po'boys and étouffée, that sounded truly refreshing.
